title: Stopped working after 3 months
text: Stopped working after 3 months. It was okay, just an ordinary clock, except that it only worked for the fall semester. Now in the spring, it seems to run slow. I have replaced its battery to no avail. It is just faulty. This is a shame because it is out of return range.
